subject: Re: POC/Trial plan and deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karen Lee <karen.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode requirements and PoC next steps

Hi Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can scope a short PoC: 

What we heard from my team:
- Primary goal: validate model latency and throughput for our customer-facing search assistant (target p99 < 300ms for single-turn queries).
- Data requirements: no customer PII should leave our VPC for the trial.
- Traffic profile: bursty peak of ~200 qps for evaluation window, steady ~30 qps baseline.
- Success criteria: latency SLO met, cost per 1k tokens within our target, and no unencrypted data egress.

Questions we need answered to pick a deployment mode:
1) Can Redwood Hosted API guarantee network isolation / encryption in transit sufficient for our legal team, or would we need Dedicated capacity or Private VPC?
2) For Dedicated capacity, what does the onboarding timeline look like (we may need reserved capacity within 4 weeks)?
3) For a Private/VPC deployment, do you have an on-prem reference and rough effort estimates (weeks, headcount)?

Ideal next step: a short PoC/trial plan showing scope, timeline, success metrics and stakeholders from both sides. Could you send a one-page PoC proposal we can review with procurement and infra this week?

Thanks — happy to hop on another call if helpful.

Sam Walker
Head of Product
Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@acmecorp.com>, Karen Lee <karen.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode requirements and PoC next steps

Hi Sam / Karen —

Thanks for the clear summary — appreciate the detail. Attached is a short PoC proposal (acme-poc-proposal-v1.pdf) and a success-metrics worksheet (acme-poc-success-metrics.xlsx) that map to what we discussed. High level proposal below: 

POC objective:
- Validate model latency and throughput for your search assistant and confirm cost profile across 2 candidate deployment modes: Redwood Hosted API (with strict TLS + customer-configured encryption) and Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in our hosted environment). If your legal/infrastructure team requires customer-managed networking, we will follow up with a Private/VPC engagement estimate (separate scope).

Scope & timeline (3 weeks):
- Week 0 (kickoff): align success criteria & stakeholders, exchange test dataset (synthetic + production samples), confirm measurement harness.
- Week 1 (baseline): run tests against Redwood Hosted API (instrumented tracing + token breakdown).
- Week 2 (scale): run tests on a Dedicated pool with batching / kv-cache config.
- Week 3 (wrap): compare results, cost model, and recommended path forward.

Success criteria (examples):
- Latency: p99 < 300ms for single-turn queries on target payloads.
- Throughput: ability to sustain 200 qps for 5-minute window at <50% error rate.
- Security: confirm encryption in transit + no storage of PII on our side (or work with you on Private deployment if needed).
- Ops: automated fallback to a smaller model if SLOs broken during trial.

Stakeholders we recommend involving:
- Acme: Sam Walker (Product), Karen Lee (Infra), Procurement (TBD).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Ben Carter (Solutions), Jordan Blake (Infra).

Attachments: acme-poc-proposal-v1.pdf (PoC tasks + measurement plan), acme-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet for results and pass/fail).

Next steps: please confirm (1) you want us to run both Hosted API and Dedicated runs as proposed, (2) who from Procurement we should loop in for a simple trial agreement, and (3) whether we should prepare a Private/VPC cost/time estimate now or after the trial.

If it helps, I'm available for a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-03T11:05:00-07:00

Marissa / Jordan —

Quick internal note: Sam's ask looks like a standard Hosted -> Dedicated evaluation with potential Private follow-up. We should: 
- Reserve a Dedicated test pool for the Week 2 run (estimate 2x A100-equivalent GPUs).
- Prep a Hosted config with strict transport encryption and runbook for data handling to share with Karen.
- Jordan: can infra confirm availability for the week of 3/9 for the Dedicated run? If not, propose alternate week.

I'll also draft a short trial agreement for Procurement to sign (minimal terms).

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the proposal — this looks good and aligns with what our infra team wants to validate. A few confirmations from our side: 

- We agree to run Hosted API first and then Dedicated as you proposed. Please treat all test data as sensitive; we will mark PII rows and expect them to be redacted or handled under the trial agreement.
- Procurement contact is me for the trial agreement (I can review and sign).
- We prefer kickoff on Monday 2026-03-09 and would like the Hosted baseline run that week; Dedicated scale run the week of 2026-03-16 if you can provision.

Sam and I will share a short list of internal stakeholders and a sample dataset by end of day Friday. Please send the trial agreement and a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff.

Karen Lee
